items.title: More Than Just Arm Movement: Finger-Worn Accelerometers Provide a Valid and Sensitive Alternative to Wrist-Worn Accelerometers for Measuring Real-World Upper-Limb Performance in Stroke Survivors
items.summary: A cross-sectional observational study (n=20) compared finger-worn and wrist-worn accelerometers, finding finger-worn accelerometers to be a valid and more sensitive alternative for measuring real-world upper-limb motor performance in stroke survivors.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，指戴式加速计在测量卒中幸存者上肢真实世界表现方面与腕戴式加速计同样有效且更敏感。这为您评估卒中患者功能恢复提供了新的工具，尤其是在精细运动监测方面。
items.titleZh: 不仅仅是手臂运动：指戴式加速计为测量卒中幸存者真实世界中上肢表现提供了比腕戴式更有效和敏感的替代方案
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面观察研究（n=20）比较了指戴式和腕戴式加速计，发现指戴式加速计是测量卒中幸存者真实世界中上肢运动表现的有效且更敏感的替代方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that finger-worn accelerometers are equally valid and more sensitive than wrist-worn accelerometers for measuring real-world upper-limb performance in stroke survivors. This offers you a new tool for assessing stroke patient functional recovery, especially for fine motor monitoring.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小 (n=20)，且仅限于轻中度上肢障碍的卒中幸存者，可能限制其外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=20) and was limited to stroke survivors with mild-to-moderate upper-limb impairment, which may limit its generalizability.

items.title: Beyond treatment: how care process factors shape physical therapist management of low back pain.
items.summary: This commentary synthesizes emerging evidence on how care process factors, such as timing of care, point of entry, and care pathway design, independently influence outcomes in physical therapist management of low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 本述评梳理了影响腰痛物理治疗效果的流程因素，包括及时性、首诊类型和支付模式。这些非治疗性因素在临床实践中往往被忽视，但对患者结局有显著影响，提示您优化服务交付流程的重要性。
items.titleZh: 超越治疗：护理流程因素如何塑造物理治疗师对腰痛的管理
items.summaryZh: 本述评探讨了护理流程因素（如护理及时性、初始提供者类型和护理路径设计）如何独立于具体治疗，影响物理治疗师管理腰痛的患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights crucial care process factors—timeliness, entry point, and payment models—that influence low back pain physical therapy outcomes. These often-overlooked non-treatment elements significantly impact patient recovery, urging you to optimize service delivery processes.

items.title: Intensive, Multi-Technology Rehabilitation Programme for Chronic Stroke Survivors: Outcomes of a Phase I Single-Arm Repeated-Measures Study.
items.summary: An 8-week, single-arm, repeated-measures study observed changes in motor recovery outcomes in chronic stroke survivors (n=20) participating in an intensive, group-based, multi-technology rehabilitation program.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究展示了慢性卒中幸存者通过多技术康复方案改善运动功能的潜力。虽然是单臂研究，但其结果提示，结合多种技术能为长期卒中残障患者提供有效的康复路径。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中幸存者的强化多技术康复方案：一项 I 期单臂重复测量研究的结果
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周的单臂重复测量研究观察了 20 名慢性卒中幸存者在参与强化、基于小组的多技术康复方案后运动恢复结局的变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study reveals the potential of multi-technology rehabilitation programs to improve motor function in chronic stroke survivors. While a single-arm study, its results suggest that integrating various technologies can offer an effective rehabilitation pathway for individuals with long-term stroke disability.
items.limitation: 本研究为单臂设计，缺乏对照组，无法确证干预的因果效应。
items.limitationEn: This study used a single-arm design, lacking a control group, which prevents conclusive causal inferences about the intervention's effects.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Switzerland: the European crossroad of sports eligibility decision-making in athletes with cardiovascular conditions
items.summary: This commentary describes the evolution of sports participation decision-making for athletes with cardiovascular conditions in Switzerland, shifting from a paternalistic approach to one that integrates patient autonomy.
items.curatedReason: 在心血管疾病运动员的运动决策上，瑞士的经验提示我们：别再搞家长式作风了。未来在处理这类个案时，请务必将运动员的自主意愿纳入考量，平衡好安全与个人选择。
items.titleZh: 瑞士：心血管疾病运动员运动资格决策的欧洲十字路口
items.summaryZh: 本述评描述了瑞士在心血管疾病运动员运动资格决策中的演变，从家长式方法转向整合患者自主性的新模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: For athletes with cardiovascular conditions, Switzerland's shift in sports participation decision-making tells us to move beyond paternalism. Going forward, prioritize integrating the athlete's autonomy, balancing safety with individual choice.

items.title: Epistemic injustice in sports medicine: framing return-to-play beyond hard data
items.summary: This commentary discusses epistemic injustice in sports medicine, advocating for a broader return-to-play decision-making framework that integrates clinical, physiological, psychological, and ethical considerations beyond 'hard data.'
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调了运动医学中 "认知不公" 的概念，并提出回归运动决策应超越客观数据，整合临床、生理、心理和伦理考量。这提醒您在指导运动员重返赛场时，要更全面地考虑多方利益与非量化因素。
items.titleZh: 运动医学中的认知不公：超越硬数据来构建重返运动决策
items.summaryZh: 本述评讨论了运动医学中的认知不公问题，主张建立一个更广泛的重返运动决策框架，整合临床、生理、心理和伦理考量，而非仅仅依赖“硬数据”。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights the concept of 'epistemic injustice' in sports medicine, arguing that return-to-play decisions should integrate clinical, physiological, psychological, and ethical considerations beyond objective data. This reminds you to adopt a more holistic approach when guiding athletes back to sport, considering multiple stakeholders' interests and non-quantifiable factors.

items.title: Cardiovascular and autonomic responses to transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation combined with activity-based therapy after chronic spinal cord injury: An exploratory study from the MACHINE trial
items.summary: An exploratory case series from the MACHINE trial (n=8) described cardiovascular and autonomic responses to body weight-supported treadmill training combined with active or sham transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation in individuals with chronic, motor-complete spinal cord injury.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究报告了脊髓损伤患者经皮脊髓电刺激结合活动性训练后的心血管和自主神经反应。结果提示该组合疗法可能对慢性脊髓损伤患者的心血管功能有潜在益处，值得进一步关注。
items.titleZh: 慢性脊髓损伤后经皮脊髓电刺激结合活动性疗法的心血管和自主神经反应：MACHINE 试验的探索性研究
items.summaryZh: MACHINE 试验的一项探索性病例系列研究（n=8）描述了慢性完全运动性脊髓损伤患者在接受体重支持下跑步机训练结合主动或假性经皮脊髓电刺激后的心血管和自主神经反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study reports cardiovascular and autonomic responses in spinal cord injury patients after transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation combined with activity-based therapy. The results suggest potential cardiovascular benefits for individuals with chronic spinal cord injury from this combined therapy, warranting further attention.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性病例系列，样本量极小 (n=8)，且缺乏明确的对照组分析，限制了结论的通用性和因果推断。
items.limitationEn: This exploratory case series had an extremely small sample size (n=8) and lacked clear control group analysis, limiting the generalizability and causal inference of its conclusions.
